title: Effectuation Wait for an Overturned Decision: External Review Priority under the Formulary Benefit
content:
**Wait clause.** When a member asks for an independent external review of a denied exception under the Formulary Benefit, an effectuation wait is added to the days of a standard independent review. It covers the time to carry out an overturned decision under the member's appeal program in the Member Appeals Program.

| The member's appeal program | Effectuation wait added |
|---|---|
| offers external review and sets external effectuation hours | those external effectuation hours divided by twenty-four |
| offers no external review | its internal effectuation hours divided by twenty-four |
| offers external review but sets no external effectuation hours | none |

The wait is added before the total is compared with the days of the drug left.

*Hypothetical programs.*
- An appeal program that offers external review with 72 external effectuation hours adds 3 days.
- A program offering no external review, with internal effectuation hours of 24, adds 1 day.
- A program with 36 external effectuation hours adds 1.5 days to the total wait. That total then places the ready day by its whole days.
